text: At a glance Formats Mixed precision PTQ Outliers Ternary Reading a name QAT 4-bit frontier Mistakes Every number in a language model is stored in some format, and fewer bits per number means less memory, less memory traffic and faster matrix multiplies.

text: Precision is the choice of format during training (bf16 by default, FP8 and now 4-bit on the newest GPUs); quantization is moving a model to fewer bits, after training (post-training quantization, PTQ) or with the model learning to cope during training (quantization-aware training, QAT).
label: core
key: quantising a trained model with no retraining

text: The whole subject keeps returning to one question: how many bits can each number lose before the model's outputs change , and the answer depends less on the bit count than on how the scale is shared and what the outliers do.
